name: Apache Cassandra 5.0 (built from code)
description: Apache Cassandra modelled directly from its source code at cassandra-5.0.9 by area agents, as a benchmark of mosaic's code-to-ontology generation.

components.name: AbstractAllocatorMemtable
components.summary: Memtable base with a pool allocator - periodic flush scheduling, shouldSwitch, and the flush-largest-memtable cleaner.

components.name: AbstractCommitLogSegmentManager
components.summary: Segment lifecycle - the COMMIT-LOG-ALLOCATOR thread keeps one reserve segment, advances allocation, flushes dirty tables over commitlog_total_space, discards clean segments.

components.name: AbstractCommitLogService
components.summary: Commit log sync thread and the per-write wait policy; the SyncRunnable loop is modeled as sync-runnable-run on this component because it reads the service's fields.
components.description: last_synced_at_ms is -1 until the sync thread's first iteration, which records the start time, as the constructor does with lastSyncedAt = now (AbstractCommitLogService.java:62).

components.name: AbstractMutationVerbHandler
components.summary: Shared doVerb/processMessage for mutation verbs; checks token ownership and optionally rejects out-of-range writes.

components.name: AbstractPaxosCallback
components.summary: v1 coordinator callback: a latch of N targets awaited for write_request_timeout from the request start; failure responses only log.

components.name: AbstractPaxosRepair
components.summary: State machine base for completing one partition's incomplete Paxos operation.

components.name: AbstractPaxosVerbHandler
components.summary: Base of the v1 PREPARE and PROPOSE verb handlers: logs (and optionally rejects) requests for tokens this replica neither owns nor is pending for.

components.name: AbstractQueryPager
components.summary: Fetches one page of a query: caps it at the remaining limit, rebuilds the query from the paging state and runs it at the client's consistency level.

components.name: AbstractReadExecutor
components.summary: Sends one data request and digest requests for a single-partition read, speculates per the table's speculative_retry, and starts read repair on a digest mismatch.
components.description: Table parameters, keyed '<keyspace>.<table>' over 'default': speculative_retry '99p' (TableParams.java:366) and read_repair BLOCKING (TableParams.java:374). The speculation threshold is ColumnFamilyStore.sampleReadLatencyMicros, which starts at read_request_timeout/2 (config initial-sample-read-latency-ms, ColumnFamilyStore.java:498) and is later recalculated from the coordinator read latency percentile (ColumnFamilyStore.java:594); a table entry may set sample_read_latency_ms.

components.name: AbstractReadExecutor.AlwaysSpeculatingReadExecutor
components.summary: speculative_retry ALWAYS: contacts blockFor + 1 replicas up front, two of them for data.

components.name: AbstractReadExecutor.NeverSpeculatingReadExecutor
components.summary: No speculation: speculative_retry NONE, EACH_QUORUM, or no uncontacted live replica.

components.name: AbstractReadExecutor.SpeculatingReadExecutor
components.summary: Waits for the sampled latency percentile, then sends one extra data or digest request if the consistency level is not yet met.

components.name: AbstractReadRepair
components.summary: After a digest mismatch, re-reads full data from the contacted replicas (speculating one more if slow) and resolves it.

components.name: AbstractReplicationStrategy
components.summary: A keyspace's replication strategy: computes (and caches) natural replicas from the token ring and picks the write response handler class.
components.description: Replication settings come from each keyspace's schema (schema-auth owns the DDL). The ring walk itself (SimpleStrategy / NetworkTopologyStrategy calculateNaturalReplicas) and the per-keyspace replication factor are read through membership's TokenMetadata contract (token-metadata.get-write-endpoints, token-metadata.get-replication-factor), so a scenario sets the ring and RF in one place. State maps keyspace name to strategy class, used only to pick the EACH_QUORUM response handler; 'default' applies to keyspaces not listed.

components.name: AbstractWriteResponseHandler
components.summary: Counts write acks and failures for one mutation, decides success, WriteTimeout or WriteFailure, and hints replicas that fail.

components.name: ActiveCompactions
components.summary: The registry of running operations (CompactionInfo.Holder): compactions, cache saves, index summary redistribution; stop flags.
components.description: stop_requested_types is a scenario lever for a stopCompaction(type) that arrives while an operation is running.

components.name: ActiveRepairService
components.summary: Per-node repair registry. Parent repair sessions, participate states, running RepairSessions, the prepare phase, cleanup and admission thresholds.

components.name: ActiveRepairServiceMBean
components.summary: JMX surface of ActiveRepairService used by nodetool repair_admin.

components.name: AddIdentityStatement
components.summary: ADD IDENTITY '<identity>' TO ROLE '<role>' (mTLS identity-to-role binding).

components.name: AllowAllAuthenticator
components.summary: Deployed authenticator: no authentication; every connection is the anonymous user.

components.name: AllowAllAuthenticator.Negotiator
components.summary: SASL negotiator that completes immediately with the anonymous user.

components.name: AllowAllAuthorizer
components.summary: Deployed authorizer: every permission everywhere; GRANT, REVOKE and LIST PERMISSIONS are unsupported.

components.name: AlterKeyspaceStatement
components.summary: ALTER KEYSPACE.

components.name: AlterRoleStatement
components.summary: ALTER ROLE / ALTER USER.

components.name: AlterSchemaStatement
components.summary: Base of every DDL statement: system keyspace guard, Schema.transform, creator grants and the SCHEMA_CHANGE result.

components.name: AlterTableStatement
components.summary: ALTER TABLE: resolves the table, then delegates to the inner alteration.

components.name: AlterTableStatement.AddColumns
components.summary: ALTER TABLE ... ADD.

components.name: AlterTableStatement.AlterColumn
components.summary: ALTER TABLE ... ALTER col TYPE (no longer supported).

components.name: AlterTableStatement.AlterOptions
components.summary: ALTER TABLE ... WITH.

components.name: AlterTableStatement.DropColumns
components.summary: ALTER TABLE ... DROP.

components.name: AlterTableStatement.DropCompactStorage
components.summary: ALTER TABLE ... DROP COMPACT STORAGE.

components.name: AlterTableStatement.MaskColumn
components.summary: ALTER TABLE ... ALTER col MASKED WITH / DROP MASKED.

components.name: AlterTableStatement.RenameColumns
components.summary: ALTER TABLE ... RENAME.

components.name: AlterTypeStatement
components.summary: ALTER TYPE: resolves the type, then delegates to the inner alteration.

components.name: AlterTypeStatement.AddField
components.summary: ALTER TYPE ... ADD.

components.name: AlterTypeStatement.AlterField
components.summary: ALTER TYPE ... ALTER field TYPE (no longer supported).

components.name: AlterTypeStatement.RenameFields
components.summary: ALTER TYPE ... RENAME.

components.name: AlterViewStatement
components.summary: ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW.

components.name: AlwaysSpeculativeRetryPolicy
components.summary: speculative_retry = 'ALWAYS'.

components.name: AuditLogFilter
components.summary: Include/exclude sets for keyspaces, categories and users; exclusion wins over inclusion.

components.name: AuditLogManager
components.summary: Listens to query and auth events and writes AuditLogEntries through the configured IAuditLogger, after the include/exclude filter.
components.description: Deployed: audit_logging_options.enabled false with logger BinAuditLogger (cassandra.yaml 1893-1896), so the constructor installs NoOpAuditLogger and initialize() does not register listeners. excluded_keyspaces defaults to system, system_schema, system_virtual_schema (AuditLogOptions).

components.name: AuthCache
components.summary: The Caffeine loading cache behind the roles, permissions, credentials and network permissions caches.
components.description: Settings come from the roles_*, permissions_* and credentials_* configs; JMX setters store overrides per setting in config (keyed roles, permissions, credentials, because each setter writes through a DatabaseDescriptor delegate that the caches sharing that setting all read). entries holds cached values keyed '<cache>|<key>' with their load time.

components.name: AuthConfig
components.summary: Instantiates and cross-checks the configured authenticator, authorizer, role manager and network/CIDR authorizers at startup.
components.description: The configured backends come from the authenticator, authorizer, role-manager, network-authorizer and cidr-authorizer configs (conf/cassandra.yaml:198,217,232,246,261-262). State keys of the same names override them, as the auth-users fixture does.

components.name: AuthKeyspace
components.summary: The system_auth tables: roles, role_members, role_permissions (SimpleStrategy, RF max(1, default_keyspace_rf) = 1).
components.description: Passwords are modelled as salted_hash "bcrypt:<password>"; BCrypt itself is not simulated.

components.name: AuthProperties
components.summary: The consistency levels used for system_auth reads and writes: the auth-*-consistency-level configs, overridden at runtime through JMX.

components.name: AuthResponse
components.summary: AUTH_RESPONSE (opcode 15): feeds the SASL token to the connection's negotiator, logs the user in on completion.

components.name: AuthSchemaChangeListener
components.summary: Revokes all permissions on dropped keyspaces, tables and functions.

components.name: AuthenticatedUser
components.summary: A logged-in (or anonymous) user: superuser, login and permission lookups through Roles and the permissions cache.

components.name: AuthenticationStatement
components.summary: Base of the role and identity statements. Executes against the ClientState and rewrites permission failures into a friendlier message.

components.name: AuthorizationProxy.JmxPermissionsCache
components.summary: role -> JMX permissions, used by the JMX authorization proxy.

components.name: AuthorizationStatement
components.summary: Base of permission and LIST statements: fills in the session keyspace for unqualified tables.

components.name: AutoRepair
components.summary: Optional built-in repair scheduler. Disabled unless -Dcassandra.autorepair.enable=true and auto_repair.enabled.

components.name: AutoSavingCache
components.summary: The key, row and counter caches (CacheService instances): lookups, periodic saving to saved_caches and loading at startup.
components.description: key_cache_size is empty in cassandra.yaml (auto: min(5% heap, 100MiB)), row_cache_size is 0MiB (row cache off), key_cache_save_period 4h, row_cache_save_period 0s, counter_cache_save_period 7200s. The three cache instances are tables of this component's state; the schema version written into saved caches mirrors Schema.instance.getVersion().

components.name: AutoSavingCache.Writer
components.summary: Writes one cache's keys to the saved_caches directory (temp file then rename), as a compaction-tracked operation.

components.name: BallotGenerator
components.summary: Generates Paxos ballots: time UUIDs whose timestamp is at least the requested minimum and strictly increasing on this node.

components.name: BatchCommitLogService
components.summary: commitlog_sync: batch - every write requests a sync and waits for it.

components.name: BatchMessage
components.summary: BATCH (opcode 13): prepare or look up each statement, check bind counts and statement kinds, then process one BatchStatement.

components.name: BatchRemoveVerbHandler
components.summary: BATCH_REMOVE_REQ: delete the batch from the local batchlog. Sends no response.

components.name: BatchStatement
components.summary: LOGGED, UNLOGGED and COUNTER batches. Enforces batch-size thresholds and sends one mutateWithTriggers call, atomic only for multi-partition logged batches, or one CAS for conditional batches.

components.name: BatchStatement.Parsed
components.summary: Prepares BEGIN ... APPLY BATCH sent as a QUERY string.

components.name: BatchStoreVerbHandler
components.summary: BATCH_STORE_REQ: store the batch in the local batchlog and reply.

components.name: BatchlogManager
components.summary: Stores and removes batchlog rows in system.batches and replays failed batches every 10 s (after RING_DELAY) on the single-threaded BatchlogTasks executor.

components.name: BatchlogManager.rateLimiter
components.summary: The replay's Guava RateLimiter (SmoothBursty, 1 s burst), created at Double.MAX_VALUE bytes/s. acquire(n) waits only for the debt of earlier acquires; its own bytes push back the next caller.

components.name: BatchlogManager.ReplayingBatch
components.summary: One batch being replayed: drops truncated tables, skips expired batches, applies locally, sends to live replicas, hints dead ones and hints undelivered ones on timeout.

components.name: BatchlogManager.ReplayingBatch.ReplayWriteResponseHandler
components.summary: WriteResponseHandler that blocks for every live remote replica and remembers which ones did not answer (undelivered).

components.name: BatchlogResponseHandler
components.summary: Wraps a mutation's write handler; counts down requiredBeforeFinish acks (the batch consistency level) and then acks the batch's BatchlogCleanup.

components.name: BatchlogResponseHandler.BatchlogCleanup
components.summary: Counts mutations still waiting for their batch consistency level; at zero runs the callback (asyncRemoveFromBatchlog).

components.name: BigTableReader
components.summary: BIG-format sstable reader: min/max key range, bloom filter, key cache, index summary and index scan to find a partition.
components.description: The deployed format is BIG: sstable.selected_format is commented out in conf/cassandra.yaml and Config.java defaults to BigFormat.NAME. With storage_compatibility_mode CASSANDRA_4 the written version is "nb".

components.name: BinAuditLogger
components.summary: Audit logger that appends entries to a Chronicle Queue binary log (BinLog).

components.name: BlockingPartitionRepair
components.summary: Sends READ_REPAIR_REQ mutations to the stale replicas of one partition and waits for enough acks, speculating to uncontacted replicas.

components.name: BlockingReadRepair
components.summary: read_repair = BLOCKING (the default): the read does not return until the repair mutations are acknowledged.

components.name: BootStrapper
components.summary: Picks bootstrap tokens and streams the ranges a joining node will own.

components.name: BtiTableReader
components.summary: Trie-indexed (BTI) sstable reader: min/max keys, bloom filter, then the partition trie; no key cache. Not the deployed format.

components.name: CacheRefresher
components.summary: Periodic active refresh of every cached key, scheduled only when *_cache_active_update is true.

components.name: CacheServiceMBean
components.summary: JMX surface of CacheService (key, row and counter caches): invalidate, resize, keys to save, save now.
components.description: key_cache_size auto (min 5% heap, 100MiB), row_cache_size 0MiB, counter_cache_size auto (yaml 525-603); keys_to_save default all (Integer.MAX_VALUE).

components.name: CASRequest
components.summary: The conditions and updates of one CAS operation: the read to run, whether the current values satisfy the conditions, and the updates to apply.
components.description: service/CASRequest is an interface; the CQL implementation is cql3/statements/CQL3CasRequest (owned by cql). The model evaluates the conditions generically: equality of each named column, or IF NOT EXISTS.

components.name: CassandraAuthorizer
components.summary: Permissions stored in system_auth.role_permissions with a resource -> role index.

components.name: CassandraDaemon
components.summary: Process entry point: applies config, runs setup (JMX, commit log, startup checks, schema, replay, ring join) and starts the client transports.

components.name: CassandraIndexSearcher
components.summary: Legacy 2i search: read the hidden index table partition for the value, then fetch and re-check each base partition.

components.name: CassandraKeyspaceWriteHandler
components.summary: Starts a write - opens the write OpOrder group and appends to the commit log when the write must be durable.

components.name: Cassandra node
components.summary: One Cassandra process. Every node runs the same code and can coordinate or serve as a replica.

components.name: CassandraRoleManager
components.summary: Roles and memberships in system_auth.roles and role_members; creates the default 'cassandra' superuser.

components.name: CassandraStreamManager
components.summary: Selects the SSTable sections to stream for a set of ranges (all, pending-repair only, or preview predicate).

components.name: CassandraStreamReceiver
components.summary: Adds received SSTables to the table, or replays them through the write path for CDC and materialized-view tables.

components.name: CassandraTableRepairManager
components.summary: Table-level repair hooks. The validation iterator over the local data, and ephemeral repair snapshots.
components.description: digests stands in for this replica's data of each table (keyed keyspace.table, seeded by the base-schema fixture): a '+'-joined, sorted set of data versions. Validation reads it as the Merkle root; streamed data merges into it, so a second repair finds the replicas in sync.

components.name: CassandraTableWriteHandler
components.summary: Writes one partition update into its table (ColumnFamilyStore.apply).

components.name: Cells
components.summary: Cell reconciliation rules (Cells.reconcile).

components.name: CIDRGroupsMappingManager
components.summary: JMX management of system_auth.cidr_groups. Set up even under AllowAllCIDRAuthorizer (AbstractCIDRAuthorizer.commonSetup).

components.name: CIDRPermissionsManager
components.summary: CIDR permissions of roles; its JMX invalidate delegates to the configured CIDR authorizer.

components.name: ClientResourceLimits
components.summary: Per-endpoint and global bytes-in-flight reserves for client requests and the global request rate limiter.

components.name: ClientState
components.summary: Per-connection session state: logged-in user, current keyspace, driver info, plus the node-wide monotonic timestamp clock and the login and permission checks CQL statements call.

components.name: ClientWarn
components.summary: Executor-local list of warnings collected during a request and attached to its response (protocol V4+).

components.name: ColumnFamilyStore (flush and truncate)
components.summary: Per-table store - memtable apply, memtable switch and flush, truncate, snapshots taken by truncate.

components.name: ColumnFamilyStore.Flush
components.summary: Flush task on the MemtableFlushWriter executor - waits on the write barrier, writes sstables per disk, commits, reclaims the memtable.
components.description: The MemtableFlushWriter pool has memtable_flush_writers (2) threads per node (capacity).

components.name: ColumnFamilyStore.PostFlush
components.summary: Post-flush task on the single-threaded MemtablePostFlush executor - discards commit log segments unless the flush failed.
components.description: The MemtablePostFlush executor is single-threaded (capacity 1), so a flush future completes only after every earlier flush.

components.name: CommitLog
components.summary: Commit log facade - add (allocate, write, wait per sync mode), sync, replay at startup, discard after flush, CDC JMX switches.
components.description: segments_on_disk stands for the commit log directory - every appended entry lands in its segment file, and replay at startup lists these files (CommitLog.getUnmanagedFiles). cdc_block_writes and cdc_on_repair_enabled appear in state only after the JMX setters change them; until then the config value applies.

components.name: CommitLogArchiver
components.summary: Runs archive_command / restore_command from commitlog_archiving.properties (all empty as shipped, so a no-op).

components.name: CommitLogReader
components.summary: Reads a segment's descriptor and sync sections, verifies CRCs, and hands mutations to the replayer.

components.name: CommitLogReplayer
components.summary: Startup replay - reads segments, skips positions already persisted in sstables, re-applies the rest, then flushes.

components.name: CommitLogReplayer.MutationInitiator
components.summary: Submits each replayed mutation to Stage.MUTATION, filtering out already-persisted table updates.

components.name: CommitLogSegment
components.summary: The segment currently allocated from (allocatingFrom) - an mmap'd 32MiB file (commitlog_disk_access_mode legacy, uncompressed -> mmap).
components.description: The state stands for whichever segment is allocatingFrom; discard-unused-tail closes it and the state rolls to the next segment.

components.name: CommitLogSegmentManagerCDC
components.summary: Segment manager used when cdc_enabled is true - tracks cdc_raw usage and rejects CDC mutations on FORBIDDEN segments.
components.description: The CDCSizeTracker inner class's counters are kept in this component's state.

components.name: CommitLogSegmentManagerStandard
components.summary: Segment manager used when cdc_enabled is false (deployed).

components.name: Commit log directory
components.summary: Commit log segments on local disk.

components.name: CompactionController
components.summary: Decides which tombstones are purgeable: older than gc_grace and shadowing nothing in overlapping sstables or memtables.

components.name: CompactionIterator
components.summary: Merges the input scanners, purges tombstones through the controller and aborts when a stop is requested.

components.name: CompactionManager
components.summary: Schedules background, major, user-defined and cleanup compactions on the compaction executor; cache writes; stop and pause.
components.description: concurrent_compactors is commented out in cassandra.yaml, so DatabaseDescriptor sets min(8, max(2, min(cores, data dirs))): 2 with one data directory. compaction_throughput is 64MiB/s. automatic_sstable_upgrade is commented out (Config default false). compacting_cf_count stands for CompactionManager.compactingCF for the table under test and is seeded, not maintained.

components.name: CompactionManager.BackgroundCompactionCandidate
components.summary: The executor task that asks the strategy for the next background task when it runs, executes it, and resubmits if it compacted.

components.name: CompactionStrategyManager
components.summary: Holds a strategy instance per repaired, unrepaired and pending-repair group; hands out background, maximal and user-defined tasks.

components.name: CompactionTask
components.summary: Runs one compaction: expired-sstable drop, disk space check, merge with tombstone purge, write, commit, history.
components.description: snapshot_before_compaction is false in cassandra.yaml. disk_free_mb stands for Directories.hasDiskSpaceForCompactionsAndStreams; history stands for system.compaction_history. capacity 2 = concurrent_compactors (DatabaseDescriptor default with one data directory).

components.name: ConnectionLimitHandler
components.summary: Shared channel handler that closes new connections beyond native_transport_max_concurrent_connections (global) or ..._per_ip.

components.name: ConsistencyLevel
components.summary: How many replicas each consistency level blocks for, for reads and for writes (adding pending replicas).

components.name: ContentionStrategy
components.summary: v2 back-off under contention: a randomized wait between p50*0.66 and 10ms..100ms (p95*1.8^attempts), refused when it would pass the deadline.

components.name: Request coordination
components.summary: Replica selection, consistency levels, response handlers, read repair and speculative retry.

components.name: CoordinatorSession
components.summary: The coordinator side of a consistent (incremental) repair. Prepare, repair, finalize propose and commit, or fail.

components.name: CoordinatorSessions
components.summary: Registry of incremental-repair coordinator sessions on the coordinating node.

components.name: CoordinatorWarnings
components.summary: Aggregates replica tombstone and size warnings for the client (read_thresholds_enabled is false by default).

components.name: CounterMutation
components.summary: Counter update applied on the leader replica - takes striped counter locks, reads current values (cache then table), writes the result mutation.

components.name: CounterMutationVerbHandler
components.summary: Replica (leader) side of COUNTER_MUTATION_REQ; hands the counter mutation to StorageProxy.applyCounterMutationOnLeader.
components.description: Runs on the COUNTER_MUTATION stage, a pool of concurrent_counter_writes (32) threads per node (capacity).

components.name: CQL layer
components.summary: Parsing, preparing and executing CQL statements.

components.name: CQL client
components.summary: An application using a native-protocol driver (or cqlsh).

components.name: CQLFragmentParser
components.summary: Runs the ANTLR CqlLexer/CqlParser over a query string and throws the first syntax error.

components.name: CQLMessageHandler
components.summary: v5+ framed inbound processor. Per message it acquires bytes-in-flight capacity, applies the global request rate limiter and the queue-age check, then either throws OverloadedException (THROW_ON_OVERLOAD) or processes and pauses the connection.

components.name: CQL3CasRequest
components.summary: The CASRequest the CQL layer hands to Paxos. Holds the IF conditions and the updates, and decides whether the conditions apply to the current partition.

components.name: CreateAggregateStatement
components.summary: CREATE AGGREGATE.

components.name: CreateFunctionStatement
components.summary: CREATE FUNCTION.

components.name: CreateIndexStatement
components.summary: CREATE INDEX.

components.name: CreateKeyspaceStatement
components.summary: CREATE KEYSPACE.

components.name: CreateRoleStatement
components.summary: CREATE ROLE / CREATE USER.

components.name: CreateTableStatement
components.summary: CREATE TABLE.

components.name: CreateTriggerStatement
components.summary: CREATE TRIGGER.

components.name: CreateTypeStatement
components.summary: CREATE TYPE.

components.name: CreateViewStatement
components.summary: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW.

components.name: Data directories
components.summary: SSTables, snapshots and system keyspace files on local disk.

components.name: DataResolver
components.summary: Merges full data responses (newest timestamp wins) and feeds the differences to read repair.

components.name: DataResource
components.summary: data, data/<ks>, data/<ks>/*, data/<ks>/<table>: applicable permissions and existence.

components.name: DatabaseDescriptor
components.summary: Loads cassandra.yaml into Config and applies it; the effective runtime configuration other code reads and JMX setters change.
components.description: Effective values used by the ops flows (cassandra.yaml first, Config.java defaults where the yaml is silent): start_native_transport true (yaml 1020), audit_logging_options.enabled false (yaml 1894), full_query_logging_options commented out so log_dir is "" (FullQueryLoggerOptions.java:27), auth_cache_warming_enabled false (Config.java:749), autocompaction_on_startup_enabled true (Config.java:833 property default).

components.name: DatacenterSyncWriteResponseHandler
components.summary: Blocks for a quorum in every datacenter (EACH_QUORUM with NetworkTopologyStrategy).

components.name: DatacenterWriteResponseHandler
components.summary: Counts only acks from the local datacenter (LOCAL_ONE, LOCAL_QUORUM).

components.name: DefaultSchemaUpdateHandler
components.summary: Applies local schema transformations and received schema mutations, announces versions, pushes changes, and answers schema pulls.

components.name: DeleteStatement
components.summary: DELETE. Chooses partition deletion, row deletion, range tombstone or column deletion.

components.name: DeleteStatement.Parsed
components.summary: Prepares DELETE, including the rule that conditional deletes restrict the whole primary key.

components.name: DescribeStatement
components.summary: Server-side DESCRIBE. Always local, reads the distributed schema and pages by row offset tied to the schema version.

components.name: DescribeStatement.cluster (anonymous)
components.summary: DESCRIBE CLUSTER. Cluster name, partitioner, snitch and, for a non-system current keyspace, range ownership.

components.name: DescribeStatement.Element
components.summary: DESCRIBE KEYSPACE, TABLE, INDEX, MATERIALIZED VIEW, TYPE, FUNCTION or AGGREGATE.

components.name: DescribeStatement.generic (anonymous)
components.summary: DESCRIBE <name>. Resolves the name as keyspace, table, index or view, in that order.

components.name: DescribeStatement.keyspaces (anonymous)
components.summary: DESCRIBE KEYSPACES.

components.name: DescribeStatement.Listing
components.summary: DESCRIBE TABLES, TYPES, FUNCTIONS and AGGREGATES.

components.name: DescribeStatement.schema (anonymous)
components.summary: DESCRIBE [FULL] SCHEMA.

components.name: DiagnosticSnapshotService
components.summary: Rate-limited diagnostic snapshots on repaired-data mismatch or duplicate rows; the replica side runs each requested snapshot on its own single-thread executor.

components.name: DigestResolver
components.summary: Compares the digests of the responses; a match returns the data response unchanged.

components.name: Dispatcher
components.summary: Hands each decoded request to Native-Transport-Requests (or Native-Transport-Auth-Requests for AUTH_RESPONSE), times out requests that queued past native_transport_timeout, executes them and flushes the response.
components.description: Incidental state: the oldest queued task's age (a load reading that scenarios set) and the QueueBackpressure incident severity.

components.name: Dispatcher.authExecutor (Native-Transport-Auth-Requests)
components.summary: Small separate pool for AUTH_RESPONSE/CREDENTIALS (native_transport_max_auth_threads, 4) so expensive bcrypt checks during a connection storm cannot starve other requests (CASSANDRA-17812).
components.description: capacity.concurrency is the deployed native_transport_max_auth_threads (a literal, as for the request executor).

components.name: Dispatcher.requestExecutor (Native-Transport-Requests)
components.summary: SEP executor that runs every request except authentication; native_transport_max_threads (128) workers. A request that finds every worker busy waits in the queue, and its wait counts against native_transport_timeout.
components.description: capacity.concurrency is the deployed native_transport_max_threads; mosaic's capacity takes a literal, so a config override of native-transport-max-threads does not resize it.

components.name: DropAggregateStatement
components.summary: DROP AGGREGATE.

components.name: DropFunctionStatement
components.summary: DROP FUNCTION.

components.name: DropIdentityStatement
components.summary: DROP IDENTITY '<identity>'.

components.name: DropIndexStatement
components.summary: DROP INDEX.

components.name: DropKeyspaceStatement
components.summary: DROP KEYSPACE.

components.name: DropRoleStatement
components.summary: DROP ROLE / DROP USER.

components.name: DropTableStatement
components.summary: DROP TABLE.

components.name: DropTriggerStatement
components.summary: DROP TRIGGER.

components.name: DropTypeStatement
components.summary: DROP TYPE.

components.name: DropViewStatement
components.summary: DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW.

components.name: DynamicEndpointSnitch
components.summary: Wraps the configured snitch and reorders replicas by measured latency when one is much worse than another; rescored every 100ms, reset every 10min.
components.description: dynamic_snitch is true (Config.java:424; not set in conf/cassandra.yaml), so DatabaseDescriptor wraps endpoint_snitch in this class (DatabaseDescriptor.java:1443,1671). dynamic_snitch_update_interval 100ms (yaml:1561), dynamic_snitch_reset_interval 600000ms (yaml:1565), dynamic_snitch_badness_threshold 1.0 (yaml:1573). samples is a list of {endpoint, latencies_ms}; scores a list of {endpoint, score}.

components.name: EchoVerbHandler
components.summary: Answers ECHO_REQ (sent by Gossiper.markAlive) unless this node is shutting down.

components.name: EndpointSnitchInfo
components.summary: JMX view of the snitch (getDatacenter, getRack, getSnitchName).

components.name: IEndpointStateChangeSubscriber
components.summary: The gossiper's subscriber list. Its event interfaces are the topics StorageService, LoadBroadcaster and other areas subscribe to.

components.name: Envelope.Decoder
components.summary: Parses the 9-byte envelope header (version and direction, flags, stream id, opcode, body length) and enforces native_transport_max_frame_size.

components.name: ErrorMessage
components.summary: Maps any Throwable to an ERROR response (TransportException codes, else SERVER_ERROR) and downgrades codes older protocol versions cannot carry.

components.name: ExecuteMessage
components.summary: EXECUTE (opcode 10): look up a prepared statement by id, execute it, and decide result-metadata flags.

components.name: FailureDetector
components.summary: Phi accrual failure detector. Convicts an endpoint when PHI_FACTOR * phi exceeds phi_convict_threshold (8).

components.name: FBUtilities
components.summary: Static utilities; here only this node's broadcast address (the coordinator the cluster convention follows).

components.name: FixedSpeculativeRetryPolicy
components.summary: speculative_retry = 'Nms': speculate after a fixed delay.

components.name: Flushing.FlushRunnable
components.summary: Writes the sorted contents of a memtable range to one sstable writer on a per-disk flush executor.

components.name: FullQueryLogger
components.summary: Logs every successful query, prepared execute and batch to a Chronicle Queue binary log once enabled.
components.description: Not enabled at startup: full_query_logging_options is commented out in cassandra.yaml (1917), so log_dir is the empty string (FullQueryLoggerOptions.java:27).

components.name: FunctionResource
components.summary: functions/<ks>[/<fn>]: applicable permissions.

components.name: GossipDigestAckVerbHandler
components.summary: Receives GOSSIP_DIGEST_ACK, applies the states it carries and answers with GOSSIP_DIGEST_ACK2.

components.name: GossipDigestAck2VerbHandler
components.summary: Receives GOSSIP_DIGEST_ACK2 and applies the states it carries.

components.name: GossipDigestSynVerbHandler
components.summary: Receives GOSSIP_DIGEST_SYN, compares digests and answers with GOSSIP_DIGEST_ACK.

components.name: GossipShutdownVerbHandler
components.summary: Receives GOSSIP_SHUTDOWN from a peer that is shutting down and marks it down.

components.name: GossipVerbHandler
components.summary: Base class of the gossip digest handlers; records when the gossip stage last processed a message.

components.name: Gossiper
components.summary: Owns the endpoint state map, the live and unreachable sets, seeds and the quarantine of removed endpoints.

components.name: Gossiper.GossipTask
components.summary: The once-a-second gossip round scheduled by Gossiper.start.

components.name: GossipingPropertyFileSnitch
components.summary: Alternative snitch: the local DC and rack come from cassandra-rackdc.properties and others' from gossip. Not deployed.

components.name: GrantPermissionsStatement
components.summary: GRANT permission ON resource TO role.

components.name: GrantRoleStatement
components.summary: GRANT role TO grantee.

components.name: GroupCommitLogService
components.summary: commitlog_sync: group - writes wait for the next sync, which runs every commitlog_sync_group_window.

components.name: Hint
components.summary: A hint; applies its mutation only while live (creation + min(gcgs, maxHintTTL) seconds) and without tables truncated since.

components.name: HintVerbHandler
components.summary: HINT_REQ: validate and apply a delivered hint, or store/re-address it when this node is not its final replica.

components.name: Hints and batchlog
components.summary: Hinted handoff and the logged-batch log.

components.name: HintsBuffer
components.summary: In-memory slab of serialized hints with per-host-id offset queues.

components.name: HintsBufferPool
components.summary: Hands out allocations in the current HintsBuffer (32 MiB minimum, at most MAX_HINT_BUFFERS=3) and swaps full buffers out for flushing.

components.name: HintsCatalog
components.summary: Map of host id to HintsStore for the hints directory; stores are created on first write.

components.name: HintsCleanupTrigger
components.summary: Hourly: when auto_hints_cleanup_enabled, deletes expired files of orphaned stores (host id no longer in the ring). Disabled in the deployed config.

components.name: Hints directory
components.summary: Hint files on local disk.

components.name: HintsDispatchExecutor
components.summary: HintsDispatcher thread pool (max_hints_delivery_threads=2); at most one dispatch task per host id (scheduledDispatches).

components.name: HintsDispatchExecutor.DispatchHintsTask
components.summary: Delivers a store's files in order, rate-limited by hinted_handoff_throttle; converts files for hosts that left the ring; keeps the offset of a partially delivered file. Runs on the HintsDispatcher pool of max_hints_delivery_threads (2).

components.name: HintsDispatchExecutor.TransferHintsTask
components.summary: Decommission: dispatches every store's files to one target node, retrying once after 10 s.

components.name: HintsDispatchTrigger
components.summary: Every 10 s: for each live store with files or an open writer, schedules dispatch of its files and closes its writer for the next run.

components.name: HintsDispatcher
components.summary: Reads a hints file page by page, sends each hint as HINT_REQ and aborts the page on any failure, timeout, dead target or pause.

components.name: HintsService
components.summary: Entry point for writing, flushing, dispatching, pausing, deleting, excising and transferring hints. Dispatch starts paused and is unpaused by startDispatch at node start.

components.name: HintsStore
components.summary: Per-host hints: the open writer (current file) and the dispatch queue of closed files, with dispatch offsets and expiry.

components.name: HintsWriteExecutor
components.summary: Single-threaded executor that flushes buffers into per-host hint files, rolls files at max_hints_file_size and fsyncs writers.

components.name: HybridSpeculativeRetryPolicy
components.summary: speculative_retry = 'MIN(99p,50ms)' or 'MAX(...)': combines a percentile and a fixed delay.

components.name: IncrementalRepairTask
components.summary: Incremental repair. Wraps the repair sessions in a consistent CoordinatorSession (prepare, repair, finalize).

components.name: IndexStatusManager
components.summary: Coordinator-side: drops replicas whose index is not queryable (from gossiped status) and fails the read when too few remain.

components.name: IndexSummaryManager
components.summary: Periodically redistributes the fixed index summary memory pool across BIG sstables by read rate (every 60 minutes).
components.description: index_summary_resize_interval is 60m in cassandra.yaml; index_summary_capacity is empty (auto: 5% of heap).

components.name: IndexSummaryRedistribution
components.summary: Resamples each sstable's index summary up or down so the total fits the pool; runs as a global compaction-tracked operation.

components.name: InitialConnectionHandler
components.summary: First inbound handler on a new channel. Answers OPTIONS itself, turns STARTUP into a ServerConnection and reconfigures the pipeline, and rejects anything else and closes.

components.name: Keyspace
components.summary: Applies mutations locally - MV locks, commit log append, view updates, memtable write; flushes all tables of a keyspace.
components.description: tables and durable_writes are this node's view of the schema (Keyspace instances and their ColumnFamilyStores); the base-schema fixture seeds them, init-cf and drop-cf maintain them.

components.name: LeveledCompactionStrategy
components.summary: Leveled compaction: 160MiB sstables, fanout 10; asks the manifest for candidates, falls back to a tombstone compaction.

components.name: LeveledManifest
components.summary: Scores levels; size-tiers L0 first when it holds more than 32 sstables and a higher level needs work.

components.name: LifecycleTransaction
components.summary: Transaction over sstable replacement: prepare (log obsoletions), commit (point of no return) or abort (restore originals).

components.name: ListPermissionsStatement
components.summary: LIST PERMISSIONS.

components.name: ListRolesStatement
components.summary: LIST ROLES.

components.name: ListUsersStatement
components.summary: LIST USERS: LIST ROLES restricted to roles that can log in.

components.name: LoadBroadcaster
components.summary: Publishes this node's on-disk load as the LOAD gossip state every 60 s.

components.name: LocalSessions
components.summary: The participant side of incremental repair. Local session state machine, persisted in system.repairs, with periodic cleanup.

components.name: LocalStrategy
components.summary: The only replica is the local node (system keyspaces).

components.name: LocalSyncTask
components.summary: Sync between the coordinator and one replica. Streams directly from this node.

components.name: MBeanWrapper
components.summary: Registers every Cassandra MBean with the platform MBeanServer; JMX clients (nodetool, jconsole) invoke operations through it.
components.description: The dispatch itself is the JDK platform MBeanServer behind the JMX connector created by maybeInitJmx (local-only on port 7199 per cassandra-env.sh).

components.name: Membership and ring
components.summary: Gossip, failure detection, token metadata and node lifecycle (bootstrap, decommission, move).

components.name: MemtableAllocator
components.summary: Per-memtable allocator; blocks writers when the memtable pool is full until a flush releases memory.

components.name: MemtableCleanerThread.Clean
components.summary: Infinite-loop task that flushes the largest memtable whenever the pool needs cleaning.

components.name: MemtablePool (SlabPool for heap_buffers)
components.summary: The node's memtable memory pool (one per instance) with a limit and a cleanup threshold that triggers the cleaner thread.

components.name: Message.Request
components.summary: Base of every request message. execute() opens a tracing session for traceable messages when the TRACING flag is set, runs the subclass and stamps the tracing id.

components.name: Internode messaging
components.summary: Internode connections, verbs, callbacks and expiry (port 7000).

components.name: MessagingService
components.summary: Sends internode messages, registers response callbacks and manages outbound connection pools.

components.name: MessagingServiceMBeanImpl
components.summary: MessagingService's JMX operations and metrics.

components.name: MigrationCoordinator
components.summary: Tracks the schema version each endpoint reports through gossip and pulls schema it has not seen; pushes local changes to live peers.
components.description: endpoint_versions, version_info and last_pull_failures mirror the fields of the same names. peers is this node's view of each peer's gossip application state (RELEASE_VERSION, SCHEMA) and MessagingService version; fixtures.yaml seeds it per instance (three-node-rf3) so scenarios can vary it. Liveness is read through membership's gossiper interfaces.

components.name: MigrationCoordinator.Callback
components.summary: The SCHEMA_PULL_REQ callback: merges the pulled mutations or records the pull as failed.

components.name: ModificationStatement
components.summary: Shared execution of INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE. Builds mutations and sends them to StorageProxy.mutateWithTriggers, or a CAS to StorageProxy.cas when the statement has IF conditions.

components.name: ModificationStatement.Parsed
components.summary: Prepares INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE (table lookup, conditions, attributes), delegating to the concrete prepareInternal.

components.name: MultiPartitionPager
components.summary: Pages an IN query by chaining one SinglePartitionPager per partition.

components.name: Mutation
components.summary: A set of partition updates for one partition key in one keyspace; validates its size and applies through Keyspace.

components.name: MutationVerbHandler
components.summary: Replica side of MUTATION_REQ and PAXOS2_COMMIT_REMOTE_REQ; drops expired messages, checks size, forwards, applies and replies.
components.description: Runs on the MUTATION stage, a pool of concurrent_writes (32) threads per node (capacity).

components.name: NativeTransportService
components.summary: Lazily builds the netty event loop group and one or two Server instances (plain and TLS port), then starts and stops them.

components.name: NetworkPermissionsCache
components.summary: role -> datacenters the role may access.

components.name: NetworkTopologyStrategy
components.summary: Places RF replicas per datacenter, walking the ring and preferring distinct racks. With SimpleSnitch (one DC, one rack) this equals the SimpleStrategy walk.

components.name: NeverSpeculativeRetryPolicy
components.summary: speculative_retry = 'NONE'.

components.name: Operations surface
components.summary: JMX MBeans, nodetool, virtual tables, startup checks and background executors.

components.name: NodeProbe
components.summary: JMX client: opens the RMI connector to host:port (default 127.0.0.1:7199) and proxies the Cassandra MBeans.

components.name: NodeTool
components.summary: The nodetool CLI (a separate JVM on the operator side): parses the command line with airline, connects to the node over JMX and runs one command.
components.description: Exit status: 0 success; 1 for IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException and airline parse errors (badUse) and for a failed JMX connection; 2 for any other Throwable, printing the root cause message.

components.name: NodeTool.NodeToolCmd
components.summary: Base class of every JMX-backed command: connects a NodeProbe, runs execute(probe), and fails when the probe recorded a failure.

components.name: Assassinate
components.summary: nodetool assassinate <ip>: forcefully remove an endpoint from gossip (Gossiper.assassinateEndpoint).

components.name: BootstrapResume
components.summary: nodetool bootstrap resume: disabled unless cassandra.reset_bootstrap_progress is explicitly false or --force is given.

components.name: Cleanup
components.summary: nodetool cleanup: per non-local-strategy keyspace (local system keyspaces skipped) run forceKeyspaceCleanup; status 2 makes nodetool fail.

components.name: ClearSnapshot
components.summary: nodetool clearsnapshot: require a tag or --all (but not both), then clearSnapshot on the keyspaces.

components.name: Compact
components.summary: nodetool compact: user-defined compaction of named files, or major compaction of a keyspace (optionally a token range or one partition key).

components.name: Decommission
components.summary: nodetool decommission: no-op when already decommissioning or decommissioned; UnsupportedOperationException becomes IllegalStateException.

components.name: DisableAuditLog
components.summary: nodetool disableauditlog: invoke disableAuditLog.

components.name: DisableAutoCompaction
components.summary: nodetool disableautocompaction: disableAutoCompaction for the named tables of each keyspace.

components.name: DisableBackup
components.summary: nodetool disablebackup: invoke setIncrementalBackupsEnabled.

components.name: DisableBinary
components.summary: nodetool disablebinary: invoke stopNativeTransport.

components.name: DisableFullQueryLog
components.summary: nodetool disablefullquerylog: invoke stopFullQueryLogger.

components.name: DisableGossip
components.summary: nodetool disablegossip: invoke stopGossiping.

components.name: DisableHandoff
components.summary: nodetool disablehandoff: invoke setHintedHandoffEnabled.

components.name: DisableHintsForDC
components.summary: nodetool disablehintsfordc <dc>: exactly one data center, then StorageProxy.disableHintsForDC.

components.name: DisableOldProtocolVersions
components.summary: nodetool disableoldprotocolversions: invoke disableNativeTransportOldProtocolVersions.

components.name: Drain
components.summary: nodetool drain: StorageService.drain; IOException, InterruptedException and ExecutionException are wrapped.

components.name: DropCIDRGroup
components.summary: nodetool dropcidrgroup <group>: refuses an unknown group (RuntimeException from the server).

components.name: EnableAuditLog
components.summary: nodetool enableauditlog: validate --blocking, then StorageService.enableAuditLog with the filters given.

components.name: EnableAutoCompaction
components.summary: nodetool enableautocompaction: enableAutoCompaction for the named tables of each keyspace.

components.name: EnableBackup
components.summary: nodetool enablebackup: invoke setIncrementalBackupsEnabled.

components.name: EnableBinary
components.summary: nodetool enablebinary: invoke startNativeTransport.

components.name: EnableFullQueryLog
components.summary: nodetool enablefullquerylog: validate --blocking, then StorageService.enableFullQueryLogger (path from --path or full_query_logging_options.log_dir).

components.name: EnableGossip
components.summary: nodetool enablegossip: invoke startGossiping.

components.name: EnableHandoff
components.summary: nodetool enablehandoff: invoke setHintedHandoffEnabled.

components.name: EnableHintsForDC
components.summary: nodetool enablehintsfordc <dc>: exactly one data center, then StorageProxy.enableHintsForDC.

components.name: EnableOldProtocolVersions
components.summary: nodetool enableoldprotocolversions: invoke enableNativeTransportOldProtocolVersions.

components.name: Flush
components.summary: nodetool flush: forceKeyspaceFlush for the named keyspace (or all keyspaces); any server error is wrapped as "Error occurred during flushing".

components.name: ForceCompact
components.summary: nodetool forcecompact: compact the given partition keys of one table ignoring gc_grace (needs keyspace, table and keys).

components.name: GarbageCollect
components.summary: nodetool garbagecollect: remove deleted data from SSTables per keyspace; any non-zero status marks the probe failed.

components.name: Import
components.summary: nodetool import <keyspace> <table> <dir>...: importNewSSTables on the table's ColumnFamilyStore MBean; lists directories that failed.

components.name: InvalidateCIDRPermissionsCache
components.summary: nodetool invalidatecidrpermissionscache [roles...]: invalidate CIDR permissions for roles (all when none).

components.name: InvalidateCounterCache
components.summary: nodetool invalidatecountercache: invoke invalidateCounterCache.

components.name: InvalidateCredentialsCache
components.summary: nodetool invalidatecredentialscache [roles...]: invalidate the whole CredentialsCache, or the entries of the given roles.

components.name: InvalidateJmxPermissionsCache
components.summary: nodetool invalidatejmxpermissionscache [roles...]: invalidate the whole JmxPermissionsCache, or the entries of the given roles.

components.name: InvalidateKeyCache
components.summary: nodetool invalidatekeycache: invoke invalidateKeyCache.

components.name: InvalidateNetworkPermissionsCache
components.summary: nodetool invalidatenetworkpermissionscache [roles...]: invalidate the whole NetworkPermissionsCache, or the entries of the given roles.

components.name: InvalidatePermissionsCache
components.summary: nodetool invalidatepermissionscache [roles...]: invalidate the whole PermissionsCache, or the entries of the given roles.

components.name: InvalidateRolesCache
components.summary: nodetool invalidaterolescache [roles...]: invalidate the whole RolesCache, or the entries of the given roles.

components.name: InvalidateRowCache
components.summary: nodetool invalidaterowcache: invoke invalidateRowCache.

components.name: Join
components.summary: nodetool join: refuse if already joined or still bootstrapping, else joinRing.

components.name: Move
components.summary: nodetool move: move this node to a new token; IOException becomes "Error during moving node".

components.name: PauseHandoff
components.summary: nodetool pausehandoff: invoke pauseDispatch.

components.name: Rebuild
components.summary: nodetool rebuild [source dc]: tokens need a keyspace; then StorageService.rebuild.

components.name: RebuildIndex
components.summary: nodetool rebuild_index <ks> <cf> <idx>...: rebuild secondary indexes.

components.name: RecompressSSTables
components.summary: nodetool recompress_sstables: rewrite SSTables whose compression differs from the table settings.

components.name: Refresh
components.summary: nodetool refresh <keyspace> <table>: deprecated loadNewSSTables.

components.name: RefreshSizeEstimates
components.summary: nodetool refreshsizeestimates: invoke refreshSizeEstimates.

components.name: ReloadCIDRGroupsCache
components.summary: nodetool reloadcidrgroupscache: invoke loadCidrGroupsCache.

components.name: ReloadLocalSchema
components.summary: nodetool reloadlocalschema: invoke reloadLocalSchema.

components.name: ReloadSeeds
components.summary: nodetool reloadseeds: Gossiper.reloadSeeds re-reads the seed provider.

components.name: ReloadSslCertificates
components.summary: nodetool reloadssl: invoke reloadSslCertificates.

components.name: ReloadTriggers
components.summary: nodetool reloadtriggers: invoke reloadTriggerClasses.

components.name: RelocateSSTables
components.summary: nodetool relocatesstables: move SSTables to the correct disk for their token range.

components.name: RemoveNode
components.summary: nodetool removenode status|force|<host id>: print the removal status, force completion, or remove a dead node.

components.name: Repair
components.summary: nodetool repair: for each non-local-strategy keyspace (system_distributed only when named) run a RepairRunner; any failure is wrapped as "Error occurred during repair".

components.name: RepairAdmin.CancelCmd
components.summary: nodetool repair_admin cancel: fail an incremental repair session by id.

components.name: RepairAdmin.CleanupDataCmd
components.summary: nodetool repair_admin cleanup: clean up pending incremental repair data.

components.name: ReplayBatchlog
components.summary: nodetool replaybatchlog: BatchlogManager.forceBatchlogReplay and wait; IOException becomes IOError.

components.name: ResetFullQueryLog
components.summary: nodetool resetfullquerylog: invoke resetFullQueryLogger.

components.name: ResetLocalSchema
components.summary: nodetool resetlocalschema: Schema.resetLocalSchema; IOException wrapped as RuntimeException.

components.name: ResumeHandoff
components.summary: nodetool resumehandoff: invoke resumeDispatch.

components.name: Scrub
components.summary: nodetool scrub: scrub each keyspace (snapshot first unless --no-snapshot); status 2 makes nodetool fail.

components.name: SetBatchlogReplayThrottle
components.summary: nodetool setbatchlogreplaythrottle: setBatchlogReplayThrottleInKB.

components.name: SetCacheCapacity
components.summary: nodetool setcachecapacity <key> <row> <counter>: resize the three caches (MiB).

components.name: SetCacheKeysToSave
components.summary: nodetool setcachekeystosave <key> <row> <counter>: how many keys of each cache to save.

components.name: SetColumnIndexSize
components.summary: nodetool setcolumnindexsize: setColumnIndexSize.

components.name: SetCompactionThreshold
components.summary: nodetool setcompactionthreshold <ks> <cf> <min> <max>: validate thresholds client side, then set them on the table.

components.name: SetCompactionThroughput
components.summary: nodetool setcompactionthroughput: setCompactionThroughputMbPerSec.

components.name: SetConcurrency
components.summary: nodetool setconcurrency: setConcurrency.

components.name: SetConcurrentCompactors
components.summary: nodetool setconcurrentcompactors: setConcurrentCompactors.

components.name: SetConcurrentViewBuilders
components.summary: nodetool setconcurrentviewbuilders: setConcurrentViewBuilders.

components.name: SetDefaultKeyspaceRF
components.summary: nodetool setdefaultrf: setDefaultKeyspaceReplicationFactor.

components.name: SetHintedHandoffThrottleInKB
components.summary: nodetool sethintedhandoffthrottlekb: setHintedHandoffThrottleInKB.

components.name: SetInterDCStreamThroughput
components.summary: nodetool setinterdcstreamthroughput <value>: megabits/s by default, MiB/s with -m, entire-SSTable throughput with -e (not both).

components.name: SetLoggingLevel
components.summary: nodetool setlogginglevel: setLoggingLevel.

components.name: SetMaxHintWindow
components.summary: nodetool setmaxhintwindow: setMaxHintWindow.

components.name: SetSnapshotThrottle
components.summary: nodetool setsnapshotthrottle: setSnapshotLinksPerSecond.

components.name: SetStreamThroughput
components.summary: nodetool setstreamthroughput <value>: megabits/s by default, MiB/s with -m, entire-SSTable throughput with -e (not both).

components.name: SetTimeout
components.summary: nodetool settimeout <type> <ms>: dispatch to the matching DatabaseDescriptor timeout setter; an unknown type is an IllegalArgumentException.

components.name: SetTraceProbability
components.summary: nodetool settraceprobability: setTraceProbability.

components.name: Snapshot
components.summary: nodetool snapshot: validate the tag and options, then takeSnapshot for keyspaces (or a keyspace.table list); IOExceptions become "Error during taking a snapshot".

components.name: SSTableRepairedSet
components.summary: nodetool sstablerepairedset: mark (or preview) the SSTables of tables as repaired or unrepaired.

components.name: Stop
components.summary: nodetool stop: stop active compactions of a type (COMPACTION, CLEANUP, ...) or one compaction by id.

components.name: StopDaemon
components.summary: nodetool stopdaemon: StorageService.stopDaemon.

components.name: TruncateHints
components.summary: nodetool truncatehints [endpoint]: delete all hints, or the hints for one endpoint.

components.name: UpdateCIDRGroup
components.summary: nodetool updatecidrgroup <group> <cidr>...: needs a group and at least one CIDR.

components.name: UpgradeSSTable
components.summary: nodetool upgradesstables: rewrite SSTables not on the current format version.

components.name: Verify
components.summary: nodetool verify: verify SSTable checksums (extended with -e) per keyspace.

components.name: NormalRepairTask
components.summary: Full (non-incremental, non-preview) repair. Submits one RepairSession per common range.

components.name: Operator
components.summary: A person or tool using nodetool, JMX or the standalone tools.

components.name: OptionsMessage
components.summary: OPTIONS (opcode 5) after negotiation: answers SUPPORTED with CQL versions, compressions and protocol versions.

components.name: OutboundConnections.UnusedConnectionMonitor
components.summary: Periodically interrupts idle outbound connections and closes those to endpoints gossip no longer knows.
components.description: Its per-endpoint submitted-message counters are metrics, so its state is incidental.

components.name: OutboundMessageQueue
components.summary: Per-connection queue; while disconnected it prunes expired messages every 100 ms.

components.name: PartitionDenylist
components.summary: Denylisted partition keys per table (partition_denylist_enabled is false by default: Config.java:759, cassandra.yaml:1438 commented out).

components.name: PartitionRangeQueryPager
components.summary: Pages a range query, resuming at the last returned partition key.

components.name: PartitionRangeReadCommand
components.summary: Sequential scan of a token range over memtables and the live sstables that intersect it.

components.name: PasswordAuthenticator
components.summary: Username/password authentication against system_auth.roles salted hashes.

components.name: PasswordAuthenticator.CredentialsCache
components.summary: role -> salted hash, loaded from system_auth.roles; a missing role caches the NO_SUCH_CREDENTIAL sentinel.

components.name: PasswordAuthenticator.PlainTextSaslAuthenticator
components.summary: SASL PLAIN negotiator.

components.name: Paxos (LWT)
components.summary: Lightweight transactions (compare-and-set).

components.name: PaxosBallotTracker
components.summary: Persists the node's Paxos high bound (latest ballot seen) and low bound (ballots below it are treated as committed).

components.name: PaxosCleanup
components.summary: Paxos repair for a table and ranges across endpoints: start prepare, wait, finish prepare, cleanup session, complete.

components.name: PaxosCleanupComplete
components.summary: Tells every endpoint the ranges are repaired up to the low bound (PAXOS2_CLEANUP_COMPLETE_REQ).

components.name: PaxosCleanupLocalCoordinator
components.summary: Repairs this node's uncommitted keys for the ranges, paxos_repair_parallelism at a time, waiting out ballots that may still be in flight.

components.name: PaxosCleanupRequest
components.summary: Receiver of PAXOS2_CLEANUP_REQ: acks, runs a local cleanup coordinator over its uncommitted keys and reports with PAXOS2_CLEANUP_RSP2.

components.name: PaxosCleanupResponse
components.summary: Receiver of PAXOS2_CLEANUP_RSP2 at the session coordinator; finishes the endpoint in its session.

components.name: PaxosCleanupSession
components.summary: Runs PAXOS2_CLEANUP_REQ against one endpoint at a time; fails on a failure response, a peer restart or removal, or the 2h session timeout.

components.name: PaxosCommit
components.summary: v2 commit round: PAXOS_COMMIT_REQ (or PAXOS2_COMMIT_REMOTE_REQ to remote DCs when DC-local commit is enabled) to every live replica; down replicas count as failures and are hinted.

components.name: PaxosCommitAndPrepare
components.summary: Commits a witnessed proposal and starts a new prepare in one round trip (PAXOS2_COMMIT_AND_PREPARE_REQ).

components.name: PaxosCommitAndPrepare.RequestHandler
components.summary: Replica side of PAXOS2_COMMIT_AND_PREPARE_REQ; commits then runs the prepare handler.

components.name: PaxosCommit.RequestHandler
components.summary: Replica side of PAXOS_COMMIT_REQ (both v1 and v2 send it): applies the commit with PaxosState.commitDirect, or answers with a failure when the token is not replicated here.

components.name: PaxosFinishPrepareCleanup
components.summary: Sends the merged high bound and history to every endpoint (PAXOS2_CLEANUP_FINISH_PREPARE_REQ).

components.name: Paxos.MaybeFailure
components.summary: A failure to reach success: explicit failures (non-timeout reasons) make it a Write/ReadFailure, otherwise a CasWriteTimeout/ReadTimeout.

components.name: Paxos.Participants
components.summary: v2 electorate for a token: natural and pending replicas (DC-local for LOCAL_SERIAL), the live ones polled, and the consensus quorum natural/2+1+pending.

components.name: PaxosPrepare
components.summary: v2 prepare round (with read): sends PAXOS2_PREPARE_REQ to the polled electorate and resolves PROMISED, READ_PERMITTED, SUPERSEDED, FOUND_INCOMPLETE_ACCEPTED/COMMITTED, ELECTORATE_MISMATCH or MAYBE_FAILURE.

components.name: PaxosPrepareRefresh
components.summary: Sends the latest commit to promisers that had not witnessed it (PAXOS2_PREPARE_REFRESH_REQ) and confirms their promise still stands.

components.name: PaxosPrepareRefresh.RequestHandler
components.summary: Replica side of PAXOS2_PREPARE_REFRESH_REQ; applies the missing commit and reports whether the promise was rescinded.

components.name: PaxosPrepare.RequestHandler
components.summary: Replica side of PAXOS2_PREPARE_REQ; promises, permits a read, or rejects, and executes the read locally.

components.name: PaxosPropose
components.summary: v2 propose round: counts accepts, refusals and failures to reach SUCCESS, SUPERSEDED (with or without possible side effects) or MAYBE_FAILURE.

components.name: PaxosPropose.RequestHandler
components.summary: Replica side of PAXOS2_PROPOSE_REQ; accepts the proposal unless a newer ballot was witnessed.

components.name: PaxosRepair
components.summary: Queries a quorum for its Paxos state (PAXOS2_REPAIR_REQ), then commits the latest commit, re-proposes an accepted proposal, or poisons incomplete promises with a stale ballot.

components.name: PaxosRepair.RequestHandler
components.summary: Replica side of PAXOS2_REPAIR_REQ; returns the latest witnessed ballot, the accepted-but-uncommitted proposal and the latest commit.

components.name: PaxosRepairState
components.summary: Node-wide cleanup state: active sessions, per-table repairs, and the pending finish-prepare cleanups applied on the MISC stage.

components.name: PaxosRequestCallback
components.summary: Base v2 callback: executes the request on self through the verb's stage when the coordinator is a participant, and records failure reasons.

components.name: PaxosStartPrepareCleanup
components.summary: Asks every endpoint for a new high-bound ballot and its Paxos repair history (PAXOS2_CLEANUP_START_PREPARE_REQ).

components.name: PaxosState
components.summary: A replica's Paxos state per partition: promised ballot, accepted proposal, latest commit (system.paxos plus the in-memory snapshot).
components.description: Rows are keyed "<replica>:<partition key>". Each row holds promised and promised_write ballots, the accepted proposal (ballot, whether its update is empty, its columns) and the latest commit. truncated_at holds the table truncation time (SystemKeyspace.getTruncatedAt) that applyCommit compares ballots against. The legacy TTL purging (paxos_state_purging defaults to legacy, DatabaseDescriptor.java:1011-1012) is not modelled: rows never expire here.

components.name: PaxosState.Snapshot
components.summary: Immutable view of promised, accepted and committed; computes latestWitnessedOrLowBound and latestWriteOrLowBound.

components.name: PaxosTableRepairs
components.summary: Per-table registry of key repairs; starts, joins or queues a PaxosRepair per key and evicts hung ones.

components.name: PaxosUncommittedTracker
components.summary: Tracks partitions with uncommitted Paxos state per table; every 5 minutes consolidates files, starts auto repairs and evicts hung repairs.

components.name: PendingAntiCompaction
components.summary: Isolates the unrepaired SSTables of an incremental session (marks them pending repair), refusing conflicting sessions.

components.name: PendingRangeCalculatorService
components.summary: Single-threaded executor that recalculates pending ranges after every ring change.

components.name: PendingRepairManager
components.summary: Holds sstables of incremental repair sessions in progress and promotes or demotes them when the session completes.

components.name: PendingRepairManager.RepairFinishedCompactionTask
components.summary: Metadata-only task moving a finished session's sstables out of pending.

components.name: PercentileSpeculativeRetryPolicy
components.summary: Default policy (99p): speculate after the table's 99th percentile coordinator read latency.

components.name: PeriodicCommitLogService
components.summary: commitlog_sync: periodic (deployed) - acks before fsync; blocks writers only when the last sync lags by more than the block interval.

components.name: PermissionsCache
components.summary: (user, resource) -> permissions, loaded by the authorizer; enabled only when the authorizer requires authorization.

components.name: PermissionsManagementStatement
components.summary: Base of GRANT/REVOKE permissions.

components.name: PingVerbHandler
components.summary: Answers PING_REQ on the requested connection type (used by the startup connectivity check).

components.name: PipelineConfigurator
components.summary: Binds the server socket and builds each channel's netty pipeline: the initial (pre-STARTUP) pipeline, then the framed v5 pipeline or the legacy pre-v5 pipeline.

components.name: PreV5Handlers.LegacyDispatchHandler
components.summary: Pre-v5 (V3, V4) equivalent of CQLMessageHandler's admission: checkLimits, then dispatch; backpressure pauses channel autoRead.

components.name: PrepareCallback
components.summary: Collects v1 prepare responses from a quorum: promised flag, most recent commit, most recent in-progress proposal, and replicas missing the most recent commit.

components.name: PrepareMessage
components.summary: PREPARE (opcode 9): prepare a CQL string, optionally against a per-message keyspace (v5 flag 0x01).

components.name: PrepareVerbHandler
components.summary: Replica side of PAXOS_PREPARE_REQ (v1); answers with PaxosState.legacyPrepare.

components.name: PreviewRepairTask
components.summary: Preview repair. Runs validation and stream planning without transferring data, then reports whether replicas are in sync.

components.name: PropertyFileSnitch
components.summary: Alternative snitch reading every node's DC and rack from cassandra-topology.properties. Not deployed.

components.name: ProposeCallback
components.summary: Counts v1 propose accepts; waits for all contacts unless a quorum accepted (or, in fail-fast mode, a quorum can no longer accept).

components.name: ProposeVerbHandler
components.summary: Replica side of PAXOS_PROPOSE_REQ (v1); answers with PaxosState.legacyPropose.

components.name: ProtocolVersion
components.summary: Decodes the version byte: V3, V4, V5 and V6-beta are supported; V1/V2 and DSE versions are refused; older-than-V5 can be disallowed.

components.name: QueryController (SAI)
components.summary: Enforces the sai_sstable_indexes_per_query warn (32) and fail (-1, disabled) guardrail.

components.name: QueryMessage
components.summary: QUERY (opcode 7): parse and process one CQL string through the configured QueryHandler.

components.name: QueryProcessor
components.summary: The default QueryHandler. Parses, prepares and executes statements and owns the prepared statement cache.

components.name: QueryProcessor.preparedStatements (Caffeine cache)
components.summary: In-memory prepared statement cache keyed by MD5(keyspace + query), bounded by weight. Evictions are persisted removals from system.prepared_statements.

components.name: QueryProcessor.StatementInvalidatingListener
components.summary: Schema listener that drops cached prepared statements when their table, keyspace or functions change.

components.name: QueryState
components.summary: Wraps a ClientState for one request and caches the server-generated timestamp and nowInSeconds so the whole request uses one value.

components.name: RangeCommandIterator
components.summary: Sends RANGE_REQ for batches of sub-ranges (all data requests, no digests, no speculation) and concatenates the resolved results.

components.name: RangeCommands
components.summary: Entry of a coordinated range read: splits the range on ring tokens, estimates concurrency and iterates the sub-range plans.

components.name: RangeStreamer
components.summary: Works out sources for the ranges to fetch and hands them to a StreamPlan.

components.name: ReadCallback
components.summary: Collects read responses until blockFor responses including one data response arrive, and decides ReadTimeout or ReadFailure.

components.name: ReadCommand
components.summary: Executes a read locally: picks an index searcher or storage, purges, enforces tombstone and read-size thresholds, applies limits.

components.name: ReadCommandVerbHandler
components.summary: Replica-side handler of READ_REQ and RANGE_REQ; runs the command locally and replies with data or a digest.

components.name: ReadExecutionController
components.summary: Holds the read OpOrder group for the base table (and the index table), and whether repaired data is tracked.

components.name: ReadOnlyReadRepair
components.summary: read_repair = NONE: reconciles the data responses but never sends repair mutations.

components.name: Local read path
components.summary: Local reads over memtables and SSTables, compaction and secondary indexes.

components.name: ReadRepairVerbHandler
components.summary: Replica side of READ_REPAIR_REQ: applies the repair mutation and acknowledges (no hint on timeout).
components.description: reject-out-of-token-range-requests is a config (false, Config.java:793); state counts out-of-range writes.

components.name: RegisterMessage
components.summary: REGISTER (opcode 11): adds the channel to the tracker's group for each requested event type.

components.name: RepairCoordinator
components.summary: One repair command (repair:N). Computes neighbors, prepares participants, runs the repair task and records the parent status.

components.name: RepairJob
components.summary: Repairs one table. Optional Paxos repair, snapshots for sequential repair, Merkle tree validation, then sync tasks.

components.name: RepairMessage
components.summary: Sends repair verbs with the configured retry policy. Retries are disabled in the deployed config.

components.name: RepairMessageVerbHandler
components.summary: Handles every repair verb on the receiving node (PREPARE_MSG through STATUS_RSP).

components.name: RepairOption
components.summary: Parses the JMX repair spec (Map<String,String>) and refuses invalid combinations.

components.name: RepairRunner
components.summary: nodetool side of a repair: calls repairAsync, then waits on JMX progress notifications and polls the parent repair status.
components.description: Waits in rounds of cassandra.nodetool.jmx_notification_poll_interval_seconds (default 300 s, CassandraRelevantProperties.java:376) and re-queries getParentRepairStatus after each round and on completion.

components.name: RepairSession
components.summary: Repairs one common range across its endpoints, one RepairJob per table. Fails when a neighbor is dead or convicted.

components.name: Repair and streaming
components.summary: Anti-entropy repair and SSTable streaming between nodes.

components.name: ReplicaFilteringProtection
components.summary: For filtering and index queries above ONE: re-reads rows that some replica filtered out, so stale replicas cannot hide newer data.
components.description: replica_filtering_protection cached_rows_warn_threshold 2000, cached_rows_fail_threshold 32000 (conf/cassandra.yaml:1822-1835).

components.name: ReplicaLayout
components.summary: The natural and pending replicas of a token (writes), or its live natural replicas sorted by the snitch (reads).

components.name: ReplicaPlanIterator
components.summary: Splits the queried range at every ring token and builds a range replica plan per piece.

components.name: ReplicaPlanMerger
components.summary: Merges consecutive range plans while their shared live replicas still satisfy the consistency level.

components.name: ReplicaPlans
components.summary: Builds replica plans for writes, reads, range reads, read repair and Paxos, and throws Unavailable when too few replicas are live.

components.name: ReplicationDoneVerbHandler
components.summary: Receives REPLICATION_DONE_REQ after removenode re-replication and confirms it to StorageService.

components.name: RequestCallback
components.summary: The callback a sender registers; onResponse or onFailure is invoked when the reply arrives or the request expires.

components.name: RequestCallbacks
components.summary: Map of outstanding response callbacks keyed by (message id, peer), with a reaper that expires them at half the minimum rpc timeout.

components.name: ResponseVerbHandler
components.summary: Handles every *_RSP verb by removing the matching callback and invoking it.

components.name: RevokePermissionsStatement
components.summary: REVOKE permission ON resource FROM role.

components.name: RevokeRoleStatement
components.summary: REVOKE role FROM revokee.

components.name: RoleManagementStatement
components.summary: Base of GRANT/REVOKE role.

components.name: RoleResource
components.summary: roles and roles/<name>: applicable permissions.

components.name: Roles
components.summary: Static helpers over the roles cache: granted roles, superuser status (inherited), login (not inherited).

components.name: RolesCache
components.summary: role -> granted roles, loaded by the role manager; enabled only when the authenticator requires authentication.

components.name: RowIteratorMergeListener
components.summary: While merging replica rows, records what each replica is missing and builds one repair mutation per stale replica.

components.name: ScanAllRangesCommandIterator
components.summary: Top-K (vector/ANN) queries: queries every range of every replica at once.

components.name: Schema
components.summary: The node's in-memory schema: distributed keyspaces, the schema version, and the merge of schema diffs into Keyspace and ColumnFamilyStore instances.

components.name: Schema and auth
components.summary: Schema changes and their propagation, authentication, authorization and roles.

components.name: SchemaChangeNotifier
components.summary: Fans schema changes out to registered listeners (client event push, auth cleanup, view and index managers).

components.name: SchemaKeyspace
components.summary: The system_schema tables on each node (rows seeded by the base-schema fixture): schema mutations, the content digest, and the full-schema dump answered to pulls.

components.name: SchemaPullVerbHandler
components.summary: SCHEMA_PULL_REQ: answer with this node's full schema as mutations.

components.name: SchemaPushVerbHandler
components.summary: SCHEMA_PUSH_REQ: a peer pushed schema mutations after a local DDL; hand them to the registered update handler.

components.name: SchemaVersionVerbHandler
components.summary: SCHEMA_VERSION_REQ: answer with this node's schema version.

components.name: SecondaryIndexManager
components.summary: Per-table index registry: picks the best index query plan for a row filter and refuses non-queryable indexes.
components.description: default_secondary_index is commented out in cassandra.yaml, so CREATE INDEX without USING builds legacy_local_table (CassandraIndex).

components.name: SelectStatement
components.summary: Executes SELECT through StorageProxy.read (partition-restricted) or StorageProxy.getRangeSlice (key range), paging when needed.

components.name: SelectStatement.RawStatement
components.summary: Prepares a parsed SELECT against the table metadata and refuses filtering without ALLOW FILTERING.

components.name: ServerConnection
components.summary: One client connection: its protocol version, ClientState, SASL negotiator and stage state machine (ESTABLISHED, AUTHENTICATING, READY).

components.name: Server.ConnectionTracker
components.summary: All open client channels, the per-event-type channel groups filled by REGISTER, and the server's running flag.

components.name: Server.EventNotifier
components.summary: Subscribes to endpoint lifecycle and schema changes and turns them into TOPOLOGY_CHANGE, STATUS_CHANGE and SCHEMA_CHANGE events for registered clients.

components.name: ShortReadPartitionsProtection
components.summary: When a replica returned exactly the limit and the merged result came up short, asks that replica for more partitions.

components.name: SimpleSnitch
components.summary: The deployed endpoint_snitch: every node is in datacenter1/rack1 and proximity sorting is a no-op.
components.description: endpoint_snitch: SimpleSnitch (conf/cassandra.yaml:1556).
