components.name: SimpleStrategy
components.summary: Places replicas on the next RF distinct endpoints clockwise on the ring from the token. Its ring walk is evaluated by membership's token-metadata.get-write-endpoints.

components.name: SinglePartitionPager
components.summary: Pages within one partition, resuming after the last returned row.

components.name: SinglePartitionReadCommand
components.summary: Reads one partition through the row cache or by merging memtables and sstables.

components.name: SingleRangeResponse
components.summary: One sub-range's pending response: awaits its read callback, then resolves the data.

components.name: SizeTieredCompactionStrategy
components.summary: Default strategy: compacts a bucket of 4 to 32 similar-size sstables, else one sstable with enough droppable tombstones.
components.description: default_compaction is commented out in cassandra.yaml, so CompactionParams.DEFAULT is SizeTieredCompactionStrategy with min_threshold 4 and max_threshold 32. Bucket options: bucket_low 0.5, bucket_high 1.5, min_sstable_size 50MiB. Tombstone compaction: tombstone_threshold 0.2, tombstone_compaction_interval 86400s.

components.name: SkipListMemtable
components.summary: Default memtable (memtable: default inherits skiplist). Each node (instance) holds its own partitions; cells are reconciled by timestamp.
components.description: State is per instance. Store keys are keyspace.table + ':' + partition_key (partitions), with ':' + column appended for cells, and keyspace.table for the current memtable's stats. The cells table holds only unflushed data: a flush writes the switched-out memtable's partitions into a new sstable in read-path's Tracker View and then discards them here, so reads after a flush find the rows in the sstable. stats describe the current (unflushed) memtable and are reset by switch-out.

components.name: SnapshotManager
components.summary: Tracks snapshots on disk and removes expiring (TTL) snapshots periodically.

components.name: SnapshotTask
components.summary: Asks one endpoint to snapshot the table before a sequential or DC-parallel validation.

components.name: SnapshotVerbHandler
components.summary: Handles SNAPSHOT_REQ (take, clear, or diagnostic snapshot) from another node.

components.name: SSTableReader.GlobalTidy
components.summary: Per-sstable shared state; syncs the sstable's read meter to system.sstable_activity every five minutes when enabled.

components.name: StartupChecks
components.summary: Pre-flight checks run by CassandraDaemon.setup before any local state is mutated; a failing check halts startup with its StartupException return code.
components.description: startup_checks is commented out in cassandra.yaml (2270), so check_dc and check_rack are enabled and check_filesystem_ownership and check_data_resurrection are disabled (StartupCheckType defaults, StartupChecks.java:106-126).

components.name: StartupMessage
components.summary: STARTUP (opcode 1): validates CQL_VERSION and COMPRESSION, records driver info, answers READY or AUTHENTICATE.

components.name: StatementRestrictions
components.summary: Validates WHERE-clause restrictions at prepare time (partition key completeness, filtering).

components.name: StorageAttachedIndexSearcher
components.summary: SAI search: build the per-sstable index view (guardrail on referenced indexes), iterate matching primary keys, fetch rows.

components.name: StorageProxy
components.summary: The coordinator: picks replicas, sends mutations and reads, waits for the consistency level, hints, and runs read repair.
components.description: Deployed settings StorageProxy reads are config entities (hinted-handoff-enabled, max-hint-window-ms, hint-window-persistent-enabled, max-hints-size-per-host-bytes, the denylist switches and the request timeouts). State keeps the hint backpressure counters: max_hints_in_progress is 128 * available processors (StorageProxy.java:202), 1024 on an 8-core node; hints_in_progress is keyed by instance.

components.name: StorageProxy.DroppableRunnable
components.summary: A stage task (counter write, local read) that is dropped without running once its verb's deadline has passed.

components.name: StorageProxy.HintRunnable
components.summary: The MUTATION-stage task submitHint queues: resolves host ids, stamps the creation time and writes the hint to HintsService.

components.name: StorageProxy.LocalMutationRunnable
components.summary: Applies a mutation on the coordinator itself on the MUTATION stage; a runnable that missed its deadline is turned into a hint for the local node.

components.name: StorageProxy.LocalReadRunnable
components.summary: Runs a read on the coordinator itself on the READ stage instead of messaging itself, and feeds the result to the read callback.

components.name: StorageProxyMBean
components.summary: JMX surface of StorageProxy (org.apache.cassandra.db:type=StorageProxy): hinted handoff switches, hint window, denylist and repaired-data tracking flags.
components.description: hinted_handoff_enabled true (yaml 68), max_hint_window 3h = 10800000 ms (yaml 80).

components.name: StorageService (lifecycle)
components.summary: Node lifecycle: startup and ring join, bootstrap, decommission, move, removenode, drain, and the gossip subscriber that turns STATUS changes into ring changes.

components.name: StorageServiceMBean
components.summary: JMX surface of StorageService (org.apache.cassandra.db:type=StorageService) and the operational glue StorageService runs behind it.
components.description: State mirrors the effective runtime values the operations below read and write. Defaults: compaction_throughput 64MiB/s (yaml 1251), concurrent_compactors unset so min(8, max(2, min(cpus, data dirs))) = 2 with one data directory (DatabaseDescriptor.java:777-778), column_index_size unset so -1 (DatabaseDescriptor.java:2034-2037), snapshot_links_per_second 0 (yaml 1162), batchlog_replay_throttle and hinted_handoff_throttle 1024KiB (yaml 157, 88), timeouts per yaml 1322-1349, stream throughputs 24MiB/s (Config.java:362-366; commented in yaml), concurrent_writes/reads 32.

components.name: StreamCoordinator
components.summary: Holds the stream sessions of a plan, per peer, and connects them (all at once, or sequentially).

components.name: StreamManager
components.summary: Registry of initiated and followed streams on this node (JMX StreamManagerMBean, streaming virtual table).

components.name: StreamManager.StreamRateLimiter
components.summary: Global outbound streaming throttles (stream_throughput_outbound 24MiB/s and the inter-DC and entire-SSTable variants; 0 disables).

components.name: StreamPlan
components.summary: Builder for a streaming operation (repair, bootstrap, rebuild...). Requests and transfers ranges per peer, then executes.

components.name: StreamReceiveTask
components.summary: Incoming files of one table. When all have arrived, hands them to the receiver on a completion executor.

components.name: StreamResultFuture
components.summary: The future of a stream plan. Completes when every session finishes and fails with StreamException if any session failed.

components.name: StreamSession
components.summary: Streaming with one peer. Init, prepare (SYN, SYNACK, ACK), file streaming, completion or failure.

components.name: StreamTransferTask
components.summary: Outgoing files of one table in a session. Completes when every file is acknowledged (ReceivedMessage).

components.name: StreamingMultiplexedChannel
components.summary: Control and file channels of a stream session, with the keep-alive task.

components.name: StreamingRepairTask
components.summary: On a replica that received SYNC_REQ, streams the differing ranges with the other replica and replies SYNC_RSP.

components.name: SymmetricRemoteSyncTask
components.summary: Sync between two remote replicas. Forwards a SYNC_REQ to one of them and waits for SYNC_RSP.

components.name: TableViews
components.summary: The views of one base table; reads existing rows, generates view mutations and sends them through StorageProxy.mutateMV.

components.name: TimeWindowCompactionStrategy
components.summary: Buckets sstables by time window: STCS inside the current window, whole older windows with 2 or more sstables, plus fully expired sstables.

components.name: TokenMetadata
components.summary: The token ring: normal tokens, bootstrapping tokens, leaving and moving endpoints, host ids and pending ranges.
components.description: The model keeps one token per node (cassandra.yaml num_tokens is 16) so ring walks stay small. Natural replicas are computed with SimpleStrategy's walk (one DC, one rack); replication factors per keyspace are model inputs here because the schema area owns keyspace metadata.

components.name: TraceStateImpl
components.summary: Thread-local state of one trace session; each event becomes a mutation submitted to Stage.TRACING.

components.name: Tracing
components.summary: Tracing facade (Tracing.instance, a TracingImpl): opens, begins and stops the session bound to the current request.

components.name: TracingImpl
components.summary: Default Tracing implementation: writes session and event rows to system_traces through StorageProxy at CL ANY on the TRACING stage.
components.description: trace_type_query_ttl 1d and trace_type_repair_ttl 7d (cassandra.yaml 1752-1754, same as Config.java:551-554).

components.name: Tracker
components.summary: Owns each table's View: the live sstables and the set marked compacting; atomic view swaps.
components.description: Each row also carries the table's compaction parameters (strategy, thresholds, enabled), which really live in the table's schema and the CompactionStrategyManager; the model keeps them beside the view. Each sstable entry also holds its partitions ({pk: {cells, deletion_ts, tombstones, purgeable_tombstones}}), max_timestamp, read_rate (hotness) and pending_repair. The View is per instance.

components.name: Native transport
components.summary: The CQL native protocol server (port 9042).

components.name: TruncateResponseHandler
components.summary: Waits for every live ring member to acknowledge a truncate; any failure aborts it.

components.name: TruncateStatement
components.summary: TRUNCATE <table>. Delegates to StorageProxy.truncateBlocking and maps unavailability and timeouts to TruncateException.

components.name: TruncateVerbHandler
components.summary: Replica side of TRUNCATE_REQ; truncates the table locally and replies with a TruncateResponse.

components.name: UnifiedCompactionStrategy
components.summary: UCS with the default scaling parameter T4: compacts a density level once it holds 4 sstables, plus fully expired sstables.

components.name: UpdateStatement
components.summary: INSERT and UPDATE. Adds a row (with primary key liveness on INSERT) and its column operations to the partition update.

components.name: UpdateStatement.ParsedInsert
components.summary: Prepares INSERT ... VALUES. Refuses counter tables and empty column lists.

components.name: UpdateStatement.ParsedUpdate
components.summary: Prepares UPDATE ... SET. Refuses primary key columns in SET.

components.name: UseStatement
components.summary: USE <keyspace>. Sets the connection's keyspace.

components.name: ValidationManager
components.summary: Runs a validation compaction (read-only scan) and builds Merkle trees sized to repair_session_space.

components.name: ValidationTask
components.summary: Requests a Merkle tree from one endpoint and completes when the tree arrives.

components.name: Validator
components.summary: Hashes partitions into the Merkle trees and sends the result (or an empty failure response) to the initiator.

components.name: View
components.summary: One materialized view; starts and stops its builder.

components.name: ViewBuilder
components.summary: Builds a view over the local ranges with ViewBuilderTasks on the compaction executor; records status in system tables.
components.description: built-views rows stand for system.built_views / system_distributed.view_build_status.

components.name: ViewBuilderTask
components.summary: Builds one token range of a view - waits for schema agreement, iterates base keys, sends view mutations.
components.description: Runs on the view build executor, concurrent_materialized_view_builders (1) threads (capacity).

components.name: ViewManager
components.summary: Per-keyspace registry of materialized views; decides whether a mutation affects a view and hands out striped view locks.

components.name: ViewUtils
components.summary: Pairs a base replica with the view replica at the same position in the view token's (local-DC) replica list.

components.name: VirtualKeyspaceRegistry
components.summary: Registry of virtual keyspaces (system_virtual_schema, system_views) whose tables are computed on read.

components.name: Local write path
components.summary: Applying mutations locally: commit log, memtables and flush.

components.name: WriteResponseHandler
components.summary: Blocks for blockFor acks from any replica (ONE, TWO, THREE, QUORUM, ALL, ANY).

interfaces.name: flush-largest-memtable
interfaces.summary: The MemtableCleaner - flush the memtable with the largest on- or off-heap ownership ratio (MEMTABLE_LIMIT).

found.title: Flushing largest memtable to free up room

interfaces.name: schedule-flush
interfaces.summary: The self-recurring ScheduledExecutors task for memtable_flush_period_in_ms - flush an expired dirty memtable, reschedule a clean one.
interfaces.description: Scheduled only when the table's memtable_flush_period_in_ms > 0 (TableParams default 0, so normally never).

then.title: memtable_flush_period_in_ms is 0 - no flush is scheduled
Still clean - reschedule instead of switching

behavior.title: Expired and dirty - signalFlushRequired(MEMTABLE_PERIOD_EXPIRED)

interfaces.name: advance-allocating-from
interfaces.summary: The current segment is full - switch to the reserve segment (waiting for the allocator if there is none), wake the allocator, archive the old segment, request a sync.

then.title: No reserve segment - awaitAvailableSegment blocks the writer until the allocator thread creates one

behavior.title: activeSegments.add(allocatingFrom = availableSegment)
Discard the old segment's unused tail (the model's segment state rolls to the new segment)
Wake the allocator thread to prepare the next reserve
Request an extra sync so the old segment is synced promptly

interfaces.name: allocator-runnable-run
interfaces.summary: One iteration of the COMMIT-LOG-ALLOCATOR loop (AllocatorRunnable.run): create the reserve segment, then flush tables if over commitlog_total_space.

then.title: A reserve segment exists - wait on managerThreadWaitCondition

behavior.title: No segments in reserve; creating a fresh one

interfaces.summary: A replica receives MUTATION_REQ - drop if expired, validate size, forward to same-DC replicas, apply locally, reply MUTATION_RSP.

ColumnFamilyStore.sampleReadLatencyMicros before any latency is measured: read_request_timeout / 2. The speculative-retry threshold.
key_cache_save_period.
local_read_size_fail_threshold; unset (null) in both, -1 here.
local_read_size_warn_threshold; unset (null) in both, -1 here.
log_out_of_token_range_requests.
materialized_views_enabled.
materialized_views_on_repair_enabled (commented out): tables with views replay streamed data through the write path.
max_hint_window 3h: no new hints for a replica down longer than this.
max_hints_delivery_threads: size of the HintsDispatcher pool (the dispatch task's capacity).
max_hints_file_size: a hints writer rolls to a new file past this size.
max_hints_size_per_host (commented out; 0 = unlimited).
A pause of this node longer than this suppresses convictions.
Largest accepted mutation. Unset, so half of commitlog_segment_size.
Pool fraction that triggers the cleaner. Unset (the yaml's 0.11 is commented); 1 / (memtable_flush_writers + 1).
MemtableFlushWriter threads (the flush executor's capacity). Config 0 means 2 for one data directory.
Memtable pool limit. Unset; 1/4 of the heap, assuming an 8GiB heap.
-Dcassandra.migration_delay_ms: MigrationCoordinator postpones pulls by this much on a node up longer than it.
Accept V3 and V4 as well as V5.
Idle connections are never closed (yaml :1067 shows 60000ms commented out).
Native-Transport-Auth-Requests executor size; below 1 sends AUTH_RESPONSE to the request executor.
QueueBackpressure maximum delay.
Global connection limit; -1 disables it (and with the per-IP limit also -1 the handler is not installed).
Per-client-IP connection limit; -1 disables it.
Largest unframed (pre-v5) envelope; 16MiB.
Largest CQL message. Unset, so min(max_mutation_size, both in-flight limits); 16MiB is an assumed value.
Global bytes-in-flight reserve. Unset, so heap/10; the value assumes a 4GiB heap.
Per-IP bytes-in-flight reserve. Unset, so heap/40 (4GiB heap assumed).
Rate of the global request limiter when enabled.
Native-Transport-Requests executor size (the dispatcher-request-executor capacity).
QueueBackpressure minimum delay.
CQL native protocol port.
Separate TLS port. Unset (yaml :1032 commented, Config null), so DatabaseDescriptor returns native_transport_port and one server runs.
Double.MAX_VALUE: the queue-age backpressure check never trips on the deployed node.
Global request rate limiter off, so the limiter is never consulted on the deployed node.
v5 default when STARTUP omits THROW_ON_OVERLOAD: apply backpressure, don't refuse.
Client deadline from enqueue: requests queued longer are refused OVERLOADED, and no coordinator work outlives it.
INetworkAuthorizer class.
cassandra.nodetool.jmx_notification_poll_interval_seconds: RepairRunner re-queries the parent repair status after each interval without a notification.
Tokens per node. cassandra.yaml sets 16; Config.java leaves it null. The model's ring keeps one token per node (storage-service.num_tokens), so this value is informational.
partition_denylist_enabled (commented out in the yaml).
Reference to membership's config; DESCRIBE CLUSTER shows it without the org.apache.cassandra.dht. prefix.
cassandra.auto_repair_frequency_seconds: the period of the uncommitted-tracker maintenance task.
cassandra.paxos_cleanup_session_timeout_seconds.
paxos_repair_enabled: the global switch for Paxos repair, topology repair and auto repair.
paxos_repair_parallelism: -1 means max(1, concurrent_writes / 8), 4 with concurrent_writes 32.
paxos_repair_race_wait: wait out ballots that may still be in flight at their coordinator before repairing them.
cassandra.paxos_repair_retry_timeout_millis: how long a PaxosRepair keeps restarting.
paxos_state_purging: unset, so DatabaseDescriptor forces legacy (TTL purging of system.paxos).
paxos_variant: commented out in the yaml, so the Config default v1 (legacy Paxos) runs.
Writers block when the last sync is older than this. Unset in both places, so DatabaseDescriptor uses 1.5 x commitlog_sync_period.
permissions_cache_active_update.
permissions_cache_max_entries (not in cassandra.yaml).
permissions_update_interval; unset, so it equals permissions_validity (DatabaseDescriptor.java:1803-1808).
permissions_validity: PermissionsCache (and JmxPermissionsCache) expiry.
Phi above which the failure detector convicts (cassandra.yaml leaves it commented out).

prepared_statements_cache_size is empty (auto) in cassandra.yaml and null in Config.java; DatabaseDescriptor resolves it to max(heap/256, 10) MiB. The model uses the 10 MiB floor because the heap depends on the host.
range_request_timeout: how long the coordinator waits for range read responses.
Guardrail; commented out in cassandra.yaml.
read_request_timeout: how long the coordinator waits for single-partition read responses (ReadCallback.awaitResults) and for read-repair writes.
Coordinator read size/tombstone tracking (TRACK_WARNINGS); commented out in cassandra.yaml.
reject_out_of_token_range_requests (not in the yaml): refuse mutations for tokens the replica neither owns nor is pending for.
reject_repair_compaction_threshold: refuse repair prepare and repair streams above this many pending compactions (commented out; Integer.MAX_VALUE).
-Dcassandra.repair_cleanup_interval_seconds 600: LocalSessions.cleanup period.
-Dcassandra.repair_delete_timeout_seconds: a completed local session is deleted after a day.
repair_disk_headroom_reject_ratio: refuse repair when disk usage + ratio > 1 (commented out; 0.0 disables it).
-Dcassandra.repair_fail_timeout_seconds: an idle local session is failed after a day.
repair_request_timeout: callback expiry of repair verbs when repair retries are disabled (not set in cassandra.yaml).
repair.retries.max_attempts: 0 means retries are DISABLED (the yaml block is commented out; RetrySpec.DEFAULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS = DISABLED).
-Dcassandra.repair_status_check_timeout_seconds: an idle session asks its peers for the outcome after an hour.
rpcTimeout (ECHO, GOSSIP_SHUTDOWN and other misc verbs).
RING_DELAY: the time a joining, leaving or moving node waits for the ring to settle (-Dcassandra.ring_delay_ms).
IRoleManager class; null falls back to CassandraRoleManager (AuthConfig.java:85).
-Dcassandra.role_password_update_min_interval_in_ms: minimum time between password changes of one role.
roles_cache_active_update.
roles_cache_max_entries (not in cassandra.yaml).
roles_update_interval; unset, so it equals roles_validity (DatabaseDescriptor.java:1848-1853).
roles_validity: RolesCache (and NetworkPermissionsCache) expiry.
row_cache_save_period; 0 never saves.
row_cache_size; 0 disables the row cache.
SAI guardrail fail threshold; -1 disables; commented out.
SAI guardrail warn threshold; commented out.
sasi_indexes_enabled.
-Dcassandra.schema_delay_ms unset, so SCHEMA_DELAY_MILLIS is 30 s (StorageService.java:325-338): how long resetLocalSchema waits.
-Dcassandra.schema_pull_interval_ms: period of pullUnreceivedSchemaVersions.
How long Gossiper.stop waits after sending GOSSIP_SHUTDOWN.
cassandra.size_recorder_interval: SizeEstimatesRecorder period scheduled by CassandraDaemon.setup (0 disables).
skip_stream_disk_space_check (not set in cassandra.yaml).
snapshot_before_compaction.
-Dcassandra.snapshot.ttl_cleanup_initial_delay_seconds 5.
-Dcassandra.snapshot.ttl_cleanup_period_seconds 60.
-Dcassandra.snapshot.min_allowed_ttl_seconds.
Not in cassandra.yaml; Config default.
start_native_transport: CassandraDaemon starts the CQL server at startup.
startup_checks.check_dc.enabled: startup_checks is commented out, so the StartupCheckType default (enabled) applies.
startup_checks.check_rack.enabled: enabled by default.
stream_transfer_task_timeout 12h: an unacknowledged outgoing file times the session out (not set in cassandra.yaml).
streaming_keep_alive_period 300s (commented out in cassandra.yaml).
-Dcassandra.superuser_setup_delay_ms: delay of the default-superuser setup task.
-Dcassandra.system_auth.default_rf: system_auth replication is max(this, default_keyspace_rf=1).
More tombstones than this aborts the read (TombstoneOverwhelmingException).
More tombstones than this in one read logs a warning (and ClientWarn).
trace_type_query_ttl 1d: TTL of query trace rows.
trace_type_repair_ttl 7d: TTL of repair trace rows.
Stream hints to a peer on decommission (cassandra.yaml leaves it commented out).
truncate_request_timeout: how long TruncateResponseHandler.get waits for every live member.
UNLOGGED batches over more partitions get a client warning.
use_creation_time_for_hint_ttl (absent from cassandra.yaml): a hint's creation time is backdated to the request start.
Commented out in cassandra.yaml.
user_defined_functions_enabled.
Guardrail; commented out in cassandra.yaml.
aVeryLongTime (3 days): the default expiry of a dead endpoint state.
Guardrail; commented out in cassandra.yaml.
write_request_timeout: how long the coordinator waits for write acks (AbstractWriteResponseHandler.get).
